risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The MD&A states 'the company has not undertaken any operation during the Financial Year 2025-2026' and that 'at present the Company does not have any revenue from operation and that the revenue mainly comprises of other income'. The Directors also cite 'paucity of funds' as the reason for not recommending a dividend. The AR discloses this as fact rather than labelling it a risk, but it is the dominant structural exposure.
- Listed by management as a challenge for the plastic industry: 'Plastic manufacturing relies heavily on petrochemicals and natural gas. Fluctuations in oil prices directly translate to unpredictable resin costs.' Global supply chain disruptions, logistics delays and import dependence for specific polymers are said to significantly impact production lead times and profit margins.
- Flagged under Threats as 'one of the major factors that are expected to restrain the growth of the plastic compounding market'; the MD&A also notes that during the year the industry faced volatility in crude oil and polymer prices and fluctuating availability of key petrochemical feedstocks.
- Management flags 'the imposition of various stringent regulations on the use of plastic with rising environmental concerns related to the toxicity issues', naming stringent regulation on single-use plastics, recycling challenges and a shift towards biodegradable alternatives as possible restraints that may limit the growth of traditional plastic compounds.
- Flagged under Threats: 'The rise of alternative materials like bio-based polymers and the growing preference for recycled plastics might pose a competitive challenge.'
- Listed as a significant industry challenge: the industry relies heavily on fossil fuels and growth is projected to increase plastic production by 40% over the next decade (Center for Biological Diversity), which management says can lead to environmental pollution, particularly in neighbourhoods and waterways.
- Listed as the second significant industry challenge: emissions from plastic production facilities can contribute to health issues such as asthma, lung cancer and cardiovascular diseases in neighbouring communities, as reported by the Center for Biological Diversity.
- Flagged under Threats: 'global economic uncertainties and geopolitical factors could influence investment decisions and hinder market expansion for plastic compounding'; the MD&A also notes geopolitical disruptions affecting global supply chains during the year.
